description: Kami tim mahasiswa Universitas Widyatama, Prodi Sistem Informasi di Bandung yang ingin membuat aplikasi web interaktif untuk NASA Space Apps 2026. Keahlian kami: pengembangan web, desain grafis, animasi, dan visualisasi data. Kami tertarik pada eksplorasi luar angkasa dan pendidikan, serta ingin membuat sains terasa dekat dengan Indonesia.
summary: Jejak Antariksa ("Space Traces") is an interactive web experience about the objects humanity has left behind in space. Visitors explore three 3D environments, the Moon, Mars and deep space, and select hotspots to open each object: the Apollo 11 lunar module, the Spirit and Opportunity rovers, and the Voyager probes with their Golden Records. Each object has a pop-up with a NASA 3D model, photos or video, and a short fact sheet. Four story chapters, a Journey Map of missions and a Sources page tie it together. It addresses [name of your challenge] by turning NASA data and imagery into a story that students and the general public can explore. It matters because these artifacts show how far people have gone, and every image, model and fact is credited to its NASA source so that learners can verify it. The site is available in English and Indonesian.
details:
What it does: a 3D web explorer for objects left on the Moon, Mars and in interstellar space. Each environment has clickable hotspots; each object opens a pop-up with a rotatable NASA 3D model, a NASA photo or video, and a short fact sheet. Story chapters tell the missions in order, a Journey Map compares Apollo 11, Spirit, Opportunity and Voyager, and a Sources page lists every credit, license note and verification status.

How it works: a Next.js website renders the 3D scenes with three.js (react-three-fiber). Content lives in a small Express backend (JSON data) and the site is built from a snapshot of that data. NASA models are compressed (Draco) for the web.

Benefits: it makes mission history approachable for students, with clear credits and honest labels where a model is generic or a source is still unverified.

Tools: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, three.js, Express, Vercel, Figma.
